decisions.reason: The source refines only the Hero V geometry and character. The deferred E and L construction requirements remain valid unchanged.
The source does not address the closing V or alter its requirement to derive from the Hero V geometry; that construction relationship remains valid unchanged.
The source does not discuss the É accent or change its required derivation from the Hero V geometry.
The request that the two Hero V arms read as one letter does not change the separate, deferred requirement governing spacing and rhythm across the complete wordmark.
Although the client references reviewing the freelancer's notes, the source neither changes nor removes the requirement to provide concise rationale with each design round.
The source changes the Hero V's visual character but makes no decision about the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its application constraints.
The Hero V design refinement has no effect on the accepted formats for accessible review images.
